\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\vspace{4pt}\scriptsize \textit{Notes:} Dependent variable: growth of real GDP per capita (\%, five-year average), 1979--2023; all regressors in t\_p $-$ 1, the last year of the previous period. Predetermined controls: log GDP per capita, human capital, investment, openness, inflation, population growth and commodity terms-of-trade growth, all in t\_p $-$ 1. Column 1: preferred H1 specification (T3), country and period fixed effects, standard errors clustered by country. Column 2: two-step system GMM with lagged growth, the wage bill and initial income instrumented by lags 2--3 (lagged growth: lags 1--2), collapsed, other controls and period dummies as standard instruments; Windmeijer-corrected standard errors. Column 3: bias-corrected fixed effects (Breitung, Kripfganz and Hayakawa, 2022), which assumes the controls are strictly exogenous; robust standard errors. Columns 4--6: wage bill as a share of total expenditure (expense plus net investment in non-financial assets); column 4 holds total expenditure constant; columns 5--6 add the shares of goods and services, interest, other expense and either public investment (5) or transfers (6), total expenditure and revenue, so the wage-bill coefficient measures a reallocation of one percentage point of spending from the omitted category; the fiscal balance is implied. Shares, revenue and expenditure follow the extended cleaning rules (Table S1). Wild cluster bootstrap: Webb weights, 9,999 replications, clustered by country. Countries row: clusters (columns 1, 4--6) or groups (columns 2--3). * p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01.\end{minipage}
